title: Withdrawal Specifications Card — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities
content:
**Policyholder Service Center quick reference — Fixed Indexed Annuities withdrawals**

| Specification | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free withdrawal share of the contract value on the latest anniversary, per contract year | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% |
| First contract year in which free withdrawals are available | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Smallest partial withdrawal (USD) | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 |
| Contract value that must remain after a partial withdrawal (USD) | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| Required minimum distributions free of surrender charge and bonus recapture | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Default federal withholding on the taxable part of a distribution | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% |

### What each line means

- **Free withdrawal share.** Each contract year, the owner may withdraw up to 10% of the contract value on the latest contract anniversary without surrender charge or bonus recapture.
- **First year of free withdrawals.** Free withdrawals are available from contract year 2; contract year 1 has none.
- **Smallest withdrawal and remaining value.** A partial withdrawal is at least 500 and leaves at least 2000 of contract value.
- **Required minimum distributions.** On every tier a required minimum distribution is free of surrender charge and bonus recapture.
- **Withholding.** Federal tax is withheld at 10% of the taxable part of a distribution unless the owner elects none.

### Hypothetical figures

| Contract value on the latest anniversary | Free withdrawal share for the contract year (contract year 2 or later) |
|---|---|
| 80000 | 8000.00 |
| 143255.50 | 14325.55 |

| Contract value before a hypothetical withdrawal | Largest withdrawal leaving 2000 | Within the 500 minimum? |
|---|---|---|
| 2400 | 400 | No — 400 is below 500 |
| 3000 | 1000 | Yes |
